0022600214.text: The Miami Heat (4-6, 8th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Southeast) head to Utah for their 11th game of the season, riding a one-game winning streak after going 3-3 on the road. The Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West) are on an eight-game losing streak and are without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), while Keyonte George (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 115-111 Heat loss in Miami on February 9, 2026, and they have not played each other yet this season.
